subject: Beitrag in Raten möglich?

triage.summary: Single parent Aylin Korkmaz (German) asks whether her child Emma's annual membership fee can be paid in three instalments because she cannot make ends meet this month — a financial hardship request requiring a human money decision.
triage.proposed_action: Forward to a human (treasurer/board) for decision on the instalment plan — do not promise approval; at most send a holding reply that a person will follow up.

details.reason: single parent ('ich erziele die Kinder allein'), cannot make ends meet this month
details.request: pay annual membership fee in three instalments

policy_reason: Policy: intent 'hardship_waiver' requires human decision (Geld + Menschlichkeit entscheidet immer ein Mensch)
